profile.name: Ajanta Pharma Ltd
profile.founded: 1973, by brothers Mannalal, Purushottam and Madhusudan Agrawal, as a small repackaging unit (Forbes India, Jul-2015); incorporated 1979 (CIN L24230MH1979PLC022059)
profile.what: Speciality formulation company: branded generics in India (cardiology, ophthalmology, dermatology, pain; gynaecology and nephrology added in FY26), branded generics in ~32 emerging markets of Asia (Middle East, South-East and Central Asia; 11 countries) and Africa (21 countries), generics in the US (51 products on the shelf) and anti-malarials sold to aid agencies in Africa. About half its products are first to market in their segment; 500+ brands; 6,050+ medical representatives worldwide (3,750 in India).
profile.plants: Seven plants in India: four around Aurangabad, Maharashtra (Paithan MIDC, Chikalthana, Chitegaon, Waluj), Dahej SEZ (Gujarat), Guwahati (Assam) and Pithampur SEZ (Madhya Pradesh); six formulation plants and one API plant for captive use; Paithan and Dahej are US FDA-approved. R&D centre in Mumbai with 850+ scientists.
profile.subsidiaries: Five wholly owned overseas subsidiaries: Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. (material subsidiary), Mauritius, Nigeria, Philippines, Ireland (incorporated 19-Dec-2025). No minority interests.

governance.board: Eight directors: three executive promoters (Madhusudan, Yogesh, Rajesh Agrawal), one non-executive promoter chairman (Mannalal Agrawal, 79) and four independent directors, all appointed from 2-May-2024 after the previous independents retired (David Rasquinha, Medha Joshi, Rajesh Dalal, Simi Thapar); the NRC is fully independent; four Board meetings in FY26
governance.pay: Three family executives took ₹60.3 cr in FY26 (5.7% of consolidated profit): MD and JMD ₹27.5 cr each (476x the median employee; commission ₹10.5 cr each, up from ₹9.0 cr), Vice-Chairman ₹5.3 cr; managerial pay +9.5% vs median employee +9.2%; three younger family members (Tanya, Yash, Veer Agrawal) on the payroll at small salaries
governance.succession: No disclosed plan; the second generation (Yogesh and Rajesh Agrawal) runs the company with no professional CEO layer; younger family members are employed
governance.pledge: 22.53% of the promoter holding (14.30% of the company) pledged at 27-Jul-2026 (CARE); the CFO said the pledges belong to two promoters not in management, for their own ventures; the MD and JMD have none

accounting.fxPresentation: Ajanta books FX gains in other income and mark-to-market hedge losses in other expenses, gross. FY26: gain ₹97.2 cr, loss ₹103.0 cr (net −₹5.9 cr); Q1FY27: gain ₹50.5 cr, loss ₹30.6 cr (net +₹19.9 cr). Company-reported EBITDA is after the loss; 'adjusted EBITDA' is before it. Screener's annual operating profit is on the adjusted basis and it nets the FY26 loss against other income as an 'exceptional item' (−₹73 cr after tax); its quarterly EBITDA is on the reported basis.
accounting.exceptional: The company reports no exceptional items in FY22-FY26 ('profit before and after exceptional items'). Screener's 'Exceptional items AT' (FY21 +3, FY22 −1, FY23 −6, FY24 +8, FY25 +4, FY26 −73 ₹ cr) are its own reclassifications of FX lines.
accounting.factoring: In FY26 the US subsidiary stopped factoring receivables and borrowed working-capital loans instead (₹212 cr at Mar-26): receivable days 94 → 125, CFO ₹1,157 cr → ₹529 cr; management calls 125 days the 'new normal' and says the P&L effect is neutral (interest cost offset by investment income).
accounting.rnd: R&D fully expensed (₹252 cr, 5% of sales); intangible assets only ₹37.6 cr.
accounting.tax: ETR 23.3% FY26 with tax-exempt plant profits; 26% guided for FY27 as one exemption ends; income-tax search outcome pending.
